subject: MHS Project PDP Space Summary and Cost Analysis
overview: The Medford High School Building Committee reviewed space summaries, comparative cost estimates, and evaluation criteria for 29 Preliminary Design Program (PDP) options. The committee approved routine invoices, a contract amendment for cost estimating, and a feasibility phase communications plan while rejecting a motion for additional benchmarking analysis.

items.title: Approval of Meeting Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the meeting minutes from the January 14, 2026 full committee meeting and the January 28, 2026 subcommittee meeting.

items.title: Feasibility Phase Communications Plan
items.summary: The committee approved a subcommittee-recommended communications plan to inform residents about the building project through June.

items.title: Financial Reports and Invoice Approval
items.summary: The committee approved $141,900 in January 2026 invoices for Left Field, SMMA, Brennan Consulting, and ADS Environmental.

items.title: Left Field Contract Amendment
items.summary: The committee approved a $17,600 contract amendment for Left Field to procure independent cost-estimating services for the preliminary design and preferred schematic phases.

items.title: Alternatives Voting Recap
items.summary: Staff presented a summary of in-person and digital feedback collected on initial design options from the previous meeting.

items.title: Preliminary Design Program Space Summary
items.summary: The committee reviewed proposed space allocations across general education, special education, vocational, and community programs in comparison with state design guidelines.

items.title: Options Evaluation Criteria
items.summary: Design consultants introduced a draft matrix of criteria to help the committee evaluate and weight all 29 design alternatives in March.

items.title: Comparative Cost Analysis
items.summary: Consultants presented comparative cost estimates across all design options and outlined cost variables including temporary modular classrooms, parking configurations, pool options, and HVAC systems.

items.title: Motion on Reimbursement Estimates and Benchmarking
items.summary: A motion requesting consultants prepare estimates of MSBA-reimbursable square footage ranges and a benchmarking comparison with Waltham and Somerville high schools was defeated.
